## SemVer declaration

- [ ] Exactly one PR label is set: `semver:patch`, `semver:minor`, or `semver:major`.
- [ ] The selected impact follows `docs/SECURITY-AND-RELEASE-GOVERNANCE.md`.

## Security and contract checklist

- [ ] Existing versioned prompt, skill, Markdown part, and output-schema files were not edited.
- [ ] New or changed sensitive variables are marked `redacted_in_logs: true`.
- [ ] No raw arguments, rendered messages, documents, responses, or secrets are logged.
- [ ] Schema, manifest, aliases, pins, changelog, and task index are updated when applicable.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes have a security-reviewer assigned.
- [ ] Local build, tests, CLI validation, and relevant sample succeeded.
